name: Does Proton Pass Have A Trash Or Archive Feature? - Cyberly
snippet: A traditional trash feature or “recycle bin” allows users to recover deleted items for a set period before permanent removal. Unfortunately, Proton Pass does not currently offer a native trash or recycle bin feature.
